title: Fixture statute: vehicle disclosure requirements
content: 815 ILCS 5/2L governs written disclosure for used vehicle sales. A seller must deliver the disclosure statement before the buyer signs the purchase agreement. Section 2L fixes a three business day rescission window after delivery of an omitted statement.

title: Fixture statute: repealed prior disclosure rule
content: 815 ILCS 5/2L prior text, repealed 2021, required only an oral disclosure at the time of sale. The repealed text set no rescission window and imposed no writing requirement for used vehicle sales.

title: Fixture statute: foreign state disclosure rule
content: Wis Stat 218.0171 requires a used vehicle seller to provide a disclosure form at signing and limits rescission to ten calendar days for odometer discrepancies only.

title: Fixture decision: disclosure rescission remedy
content: Fixture Appellate Court decision 2024 IL App (1st) 010101 holds that an omitted written disclosure under 815 ILCS 5/2L entitles the buyer to rescind within three business days of actual notice. The court rejected the argument that signing waived the disclosure duty.

title: Fixture regulation: escrow deposit deadline
content: Fixture regulation 68 Ill Adm Code 1450.210 requires the escrowee to deposit earnest money by the next banking day after the accepted offer. Late deposit exposes the escrowee to a forfeiture remedy.
